entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it about 12 days ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's definitely a preference thing. To be honest, I just find it hard to use. The menu system is a bit confusing, and I just expected more from the interface.
I see. And you've had a chance to look through the instructions?
Yes, I read the user manual, but it didn't really help clarify things. It seems like a good product, just not the right fit for me. What are my options for a return?
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order details here... Okay, I see the delivery date was 12 days ago. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, 10 days? That's great news. So, does that mean I can get a full refund?
Yes, absolutely. Since it's in the original condition, you're eligible for a full refund. I can generate a prepaid return label and email it to you right now.
That would be perfect. I appreciate you making this so straightforward. Thank you, Alex.

You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
